items.Sentence: The turbidity of the filter effluent shall be continuously measured and recorded at Monitoring Location INT-001B.
The UV transmittance of the effluent from the UV disinfection system shall be monitored continuously and recorded at Monitoring Location INT-002.

Mitigation of the event shall consist of diverting the non-compliant effluent, land application at Discharge Point 003, or automatically activated chemical addition to comply with title 22 requirements (sections 60304 and 60307).
Any inadequately treated and disinfected wastewater shall be diverted to a storage basin or an upstream process for adequate treatment.
